messages:
Maya Li: mid-day microcatch — quick round. What I did: finished the spec for routing failover (PR up), ran the smoke matrix against staging. Blockers: seeing intermittent 503s on the /v1/generate endpoint when sequence > 1024, unclear if it's batching or kernel selection. Today: triage logs, open a mitigator if needed, and ship the canary config if green.
Alex R: nice. PR link? also can you drop the failing trace id so I can grep?
Maya Li: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/serving/+/4321. Trace id: 2026-03-11T13:24:07Z:span=svc-gen-7f3b. Repro steps in the PR description.
Sahil K: I saw that 503 yesterday — looked like evictions during long sequences. Quick check: what's the batch config for that job?
Maya Li: batch_policy: {max_batch: 32, max_delay_ms: 12} (in canary). Trying a smaller max_batch locally to see impact.
Jen O: FYI I updated the rollout checklist with a fallback to the smaller LLM quantized variant if latency spikes > 30% for 5m. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/rollout-checklist
Liam: pinging for CR review on the spec doc — left comments around the fallback ordering and the cache invalidation step.
Alex R: I can take CR now, will do a quick pass in ~20m.
Sahil K: Quick thought — if kv-cache eviction is correlated, we should log kv cache hits/misses per request id. Might add a temporary metric: kv_evictions_count_by_model.
Maya Li: good call. I'll add a telemetry event for this sprint.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued: canary/2026-03-11-13:40 -> staging. Status: queued.
Jen O: blocker for me — need confirmation from infra on increasing node_limit for canary to avoid autoscale thrash. @Alex R can you nudge infra?
Alex R: looping infra in #eng-infra, posted a short note — @infra-team can we bump node_limit from 4->6 for the 30min canary window?
Maya Li: if infra approves, I'll proceed with canary at 14:00. If we still see 503s, we'll roll back and switch to the quantized fallback.
Liam: added a tiny test to the e2e suite to simulate sequence 1500 (long tail). Runs in ~6m locally.
Sahil K: I'll watch logs and set an alert for 5xx rate > 0.5% for the canary.
Maya Li: thanks all — next update after canary starts. :thumbsup:
